messages:
lia (devex): Support forwarded a case: user runs `ri quickstart` immediately after signup and the CLI prints `402 Payment Required`. Then the CLI retries for several minutes and blocks the user's CI. They never saw a billing prompt during signup.

noah (sdk): can you paste the raw lines? want to confirm whether the retries are from the http client or the top-level CLI loop.

lia (devex): user pasted:
```
2026-09-15T07:45:12Z ri-cli INFO POST /v1/firstcall -> 402 Payment Required
2026-09-15T07:45:12Z ri-cli WARN retrying request (1/6) after 1200ms
2026-09-15T07:45:13Z ri-cli INFO POST /v1/firstcall -> 402 Payment Required
... repeats until exit
```
They also ran `ri account status` and saw `billing_state: pending` and no workspace returned.

arun (eng): 402 is not transient. CLI should fast-fail. Looks like the recent retry refactor made the generic middleware re-attempt many 4xx responses unless explicitly blacklisted. Python treats 401/402 as terminal, Node/Go diverged.

noah (sdk): I'll update the retry middleware to mark 401 and 402 non-retryable across SDKs and add a parity test in CI. Also will change the CLI to print an actionable message and exit non-zero immediately.

lia (devex): Suggested CLI UX: when we detect a blocked org (billing_state in [blocked, pending_action]), CLI should print a clear message with actions: 1) show org id, 2) "Complete billing at https://console.redwood.ai/settings/billing or run `ri billing add-card`", 3) if SSO signup include "Ask your org admin to complete billing". Also no noisy retries.

noah (sdk): opened RD-8892 and PRs: node-sdk#834, go-sdk#611. Adding an integration test that simulates a blocked org returning 402 and asserts the CLI exits within 2s, prints the help blurb, and emits telemetry `cli.onboard.blocked`.

arun (eng): I'll backport to the dedicated/dp-cli branch and add a dashboard panel for "4xx retries" so we detect regressions.

lia (devex): For immediate support guidance I told the user: 1) run `ri account status` and share `org_id` + `billing_state`, 2) if `billing_state` is `pending`/`blocked` go to billing console or ask admin, 3) if signup looked successful but workspace missing, escalate with org id and signup email. I'll write a short KB note with copy-paste replies.

deploy-bot: Deployed ri-cli v0.12.0-rc1 to staging with non-retry 401/402 behavior and improved blocked-org messaging. Running quickstart smoke suite. :rocket:

noah (sdk): will follow up with a small CLI flag `--fast-fail-on-client-error` for CI users and a unit test to avoid future regressions. Lia, can you put the KB draft in the onboarding repo and link RD-8892?

lia (devex): yes, will draft KB and monitor support tickets for a week. Marking RD-8892 as "onboarding friction" and assigning to me. Thanks all. :memo:
